name: Stars Smile
note: Stars Smile (ابتسامة النجوم), a Saudi dental and dermatology clinics chain based in Jeddah. Its own account announced it as official sponsor of Al Riyadh in September 2024. Ownership not found: the Stars Smile app store listing names developer 'Rama Medical Group' (lead, not an ownership source). Stays unrated until an ownership claim is sourced.
